name: team-messaging
description: Team agent messaging: a poll-mode channel MCP server, Stop and SessionStart hooks that wake the session for new messages, and join/bind/claim/status/watch skills. One agent session per bound project.

broker_url.title: Broker URL
broker_url.description: HTTPS broker URL (plain HTTP only on loopback) of the saved credential. Written by team-messaging join or bind; projects are bound in their own .claude/settings.local.json.

token_file.title: Credential file
token_file.description: Path of the mode-0600 credential file join saved for this broker URL; the token itself is never stored in plugin configuration. Hand-named files are refused since 0.10.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Unused since 0.10 (projects hold their binding); a 0.9 value is only offered for /team-messaging:bind --adopt-global.

session_id.title: Pinned session ID
session_id.description: Unused since 0.10 (projects hold their broker session).

mode.title: Delivery mode
mode.description: poll (default); push only when started with the development channels flag.

arm.title: Watcher arm
arm.description: rewake (Stop hook wakes an idle session), bash (skill-started background watcher) or off. Changing it needs a Claude Code restart.
